$comment: ITEMISES EVERY FILE IN THIS PROJECT FOLDER, AND EVERY FILE THE ENGINE IS PERMITTED
TO WRITE INTO A CLIENT CODELINE.
This is a DECLARATION OF INTENT, not a description of the folder. It must never be
generated by scanning the directory: a generated copy can only ever agree with
reality, so it could not catch an orphan, a stale backup, or a file that failed to
deploy. Its entire value is that it was written independently and is compared
against what is actually on disk.
Consumers must resolve project files THROUGH this manifest by key, never by a
hardcoded filename. Today they do the opposite — dependency-scan-plugin.js joins
the literal 'dependency-check.json' and git-ops.sh joins the literal 'plugins.json'
— which is why the folder layout is currently hardcoded into every consumer.

roles.config: Operator-maintained declaration. Never regenerated by a run.
roles.canonical: Immutable input. The restore source a run copies FROM.
roles.generated: Written by the pipeline. Safe to delete; recreated each run.
roles.backup: Point-in-time copy taken before a destructive step. Disposable.
roles.reference: Documentation for humans and agents. Not read as config.
roles.prompt: A project-authority PROMPT. One JSON per prompt, rendered by lib/prompt-library.js. The generic templates are NEVER executed — this is what runs. Distinct from 'config' because a prompt is an instruction to an agent, and distinct from 'generated' because it must survive a reset: the library fails closed when it is missing.

deployTargets.main-only: Lives in epam-cli only. The engine MUST NOT write it to a client repo.
deployTargets.codeline: Deliberately provisioned into <codeline>/.epam/ so writers, gates and worktrees can read it.

config.env.purpose: Project environment the launcher sources before a run.

llmSettings.purpose: Per-model temperature/effort, timeouts, retry counts. The single source of truth for temperature.

dependencyCheck.purpose: Import-scan declarations: vendorDirs, moduleRoots, manifestFile, importPattern. Resolved via EPAM_PROJECT_CONFIG_DIR — deliberately NOT written into the client repo.

projectRoles.purpose: Role definitions agents are minted against. Written by the agent mint each run and cleared by the pre-run reset — it is not operator config, and declaring it required made a run-produced file look like something a human maintains.

projectInvestigators.purpose: Investigator definitions for the spec pass. Written by the agent mint each run and cleared by the pre-run reset — it is not operator config, and declaring it required made a run-produced file look like something a human maintains.

codelineFacts.purpose: Per-codeline facts. One of only three files provisioned into a client repo.

prdRuntime.ingestedFrom: the tracker (JIRA_JQL) plus this project's own config.env
prdRuntime.purpose: The PRD a run executes. INGESTED every run and never restored from a stored file: a template made one run's output the next run's premise, and its frozen codeline scope stopped discovery running at all.

prdBackups.purpose: Pre-mutation copies making a destructive PRD step reversible. Nothing reads them; prune freely.
prdBackups.$note: Three exist as of 2026-08-11 and no step prunes them. Retention is undeclared — decide a policy or they accumulate indefinitely.

agentProfiles.purpose: Minted agent profiles. Restored to a canonical base state at run start.

vcFormSamples.purpose: Worked examples of well-formed verification criteria.

runs.purpose: Per-run working state and checkpoints. Evidence — never discarded for disk space.

prompts.purpose: PROJECT-AUTHORITY PROMPTS. One JSON per prompt, rendered by lib/prompt-library.js. The generic templates in orchestrations/prompts/templates are NEVER executed; this folder is what runs. Today these are straight copies of the templates — under the target design a mint-time prompt-builder agent generates them, guided by the templates, and self-heal is the only thing that may mutate them afterwards.

manifest.purpose: This declaration itself. Undeclared, it was the one file in the folder that no rule applied to.

$comment: The COMPLETE set of files the engine may create inside a client codeline, under
<codeline>/.epam/. Anything found there and not listed here is an unauthorised
write to a client repository and must fail the audit.

settings.json.purpose: Plugin/tool wiring for agents running against this codeline.

verification.json.how: generated at provisioning time from the repo's OWN scripts
verification.json.purpose: How this project builds, type-checks and tests itself, and how its failures are identified.
